title: Dwayne:
title_q: “Why doesn't this guy just go get an apartment?”
headline: A county official asked why a homeless man doesn't just get an apartment. Dwayne asks you to think about what that really takes.
story: The only video of the 12 where we see Dwayne's face. Open on the official's question: “why doesn't this guy just go get an apartment?” Then Dwayne tells the story behind it: a man with nowhere to go, no affordable housing, a call to the commission, and nothing changed.
Then the turn: “Let that sink in.” Think what it takes to get an apartment when you are homeless and a rainy week means no pay. Calm and clear, not angry. End on the ask.
